conclusions: The original finite-dimensional CptCoef class has bounded support on the closed unitary group and a positive Gram margin. The statement retains every relevant block head and every original base frame, compact representation and Haar measure.

The displayed section is exactly the cofactor/projection construction in HcoSmulRight. QRQ=0, K+K*=R and QK=0 force the last row of M to vanish and give the prescribed cross matrix and source Gram form. Only det Z, its cofactor-vector norm and positive Gram quantities are divided by; no internal leading minor is assumed nonzero.

Indefinite Gram-Schmidt gives the exact hyperbolic duals and positive vector. The paired Gram determinant is (-1)^n G. Both D-frame cofactor projections have the prescribed positive real factors s/abs(det Z) and sprime/abs(det Z), including unequal T,Tprime.

The paired frame has signature (n,n), proved by the nonsingular diagonal-scaling homotopy. Its complement is positive definite of dimension k-1. Uniformly bounded source and target paired frames therefore bound any intervening unitary map, because the paired Gram inverses and positive-complement norms are uniformly controlled on compact sets. This proves the needed local properness of both N0 integrations.

Differentiation under the fibre integral is justified by that local compactness. Derivatives act on the smooth original coefficient and the explicit section, while compact representation factors are bounded. The matrix support is contained in the compact reduced-matrix image of the original support and remains at G>=epsilon, so zero extension is smooth and compactly supported inside GL_n.

Transitivity on fibres uses the exact paired-frame isometry and the positive complement. The full three-part D-frame condition forces the two compact factors to match through m0 and hence cancel; harmonic-value or scalar orbital invariance alone is not substituted. This is the exact frame_fix argument, including its commutation and fixed-complement hypotheses.

The original Eichler section preserves the middle projection, acts by the prescribed upper flag matrix and commutes with the compact stabilizer. Adjugate identities give the exact cofactor transformation under both upper translations. Thus compact cancellation applies to all cells and no representation scalar remains.

The product of planar upper-root Haar measure and an arbitrary kernel Haar measure pushes forward to a nonzero locally finite left Haar measure on N. The two original Haar measures consequently introduce the exact positive constants cL,cR. Their values are retained and rescaling a kernel measure cancels its constant.

The discarded stabilizer roots lift by their isometry on the paired frame, extended identically on the positive complement. The lift is unipotent, so its compact middle quotient is identity and it lies in the original unipotent intersection. Its kernel is a unipotent subgroup of a compact joint-frame stabilizer and is trivial. Hence the source muR, defined by pushforward through this inverse, is exactly the stated root measure.

Root-height triangular coordinates have real Jacobian one. The normalized quotient cut removes exactly the discarded stabilizer measure. Fixed-head Gaussian recovery and fibre properness give absolute convergence, so changes of integration order and quotient representatives are valid.

Both original character signs are correct: cStd=-2i, betaU=2i, left conjugation and right character inversion each become psi_betaU. Phi_F=cL*cR*I_F(gamma_Z) therefore satisfies every original PhiZero equality, with no probability renormalization of compact Haar measures.

The compact KloostDens theorem and established regular big-cell equality give DensC. Invalid heads are zero directly from the original vecV definition, completing the full universal quantifier, not only the relevant-head subset.
